# no-restricted-tags

Disallow listed tags and tags matching listed regular expressions.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tags | no | no | `{"tags":[],"patterns":[]}` |

Reports tags listed in `tags` or matching a regular expression in `patterns`.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-restricted-tags": ["error", {"tags":[],"patterns":[]}] } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
@wip
```
